name: Cinchophen

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Italy, first in 1991 — for liver harm

summary: Cinchophen was removed from the market in Germany and Italy starting in 1991 due to harm caused to the liver [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a high risk score of 78 for the liver [M]. That same computer model, which also was not tested on humans, assigned it a low risk score of 8 for the heart [M].
